independent_input_declaration.basis: Independent whole-original-entry assessment against the allowed complete summary, frozen source-checked keys, and actually asked scope. Every substantive same-entry field, including all evidence text, assessed; restated questions and clause labels treated as scaffolding. Context checked for falsehood but not used as extra omission gates. Correct complete operative quotes can supply ordinary lookup facts; concrete requested counts remain required.

required_facts.reason: Both direct answer and same-entry Yengii evidence say inventions are not automatically shared; unlicensed players receive none at Confluence.

The recipient puts their own matching species card into play permanently.
Licensing cannot restore a card hidden under an upgrade.

results.whole_entry_assessment: The direct answer, every requested result, and both substantive Yengii licensing and quoted invention claims agree with the summary. All four asked facts are resolved without a contrary actor, timing or permanence assertion.

Receiving Envoys output only as a gift does not establish protection.

results.whole_entry_assessment: The direct answer and per-clause results correctly distinguish actual Trade protection from the two gift scenarios and correctly give theft timing and the repeated-target restriction. The full Zeth quotation adds accurate contextual rules.

The same-entry complete Setup quote explicitly says to shuffle eras separately and stack I above II above III above IV; the direct order agrees.

results.whole_entry_assessment: All asserted selections, ordering, dealing procedures and visible species-card information are accurate, including the full Setup evidence. However, the question explicitly asks how many, and neither the answers nor requested results give six colony spaces and five research spaces as concrete quantities. The complete quote supplies the ordinary shuffling and initial-track-dealing facts but does not replace the missing concrete quantities. No material false assertion or unsupported guess is present.
